screen:imaging/fullscreen_image_viewer.d.why: Phone-only. live_preview_area.dart:239 gates FullscreenImageViewer.show on `Responsive.isPhone(context)`; on the 1600x900 desktop window the preview onTap is null. The toolbar's four zoom buttons are 'Zoom in'/'Zoom out'/'1:1 zoom'/'Fit to window' (imaging_preview_toolbar.dart:626-644) - none of them opens the fullscreen viewer.

screen:imaging/meridian_flip_countdown_b.why: Mounted unconditionally at imaging_screen.dart:195 but renders nothing unless a meridian flip is pending. The simulated mount stayed Parked at RA 00h00m/Dec +00 for the whole session (no target, no tracking), so no flip could ever be scheduled.

screen:guiding/mobile_sections.dart.why: Phone layout only. The harness runs a fixed 1600x900 window on Xvfb and drive_linux.py has no window-resize command, so the Responsive.isMobile branch of guiding_screen.dart could not be entered.

seq-node:PolarAlignmentNode.why: Not present in the node palette. I enumerated every palette category live (Target, Imaging, Science, Guiding, Mount, Dome, Flat Panel, Focus, Camera, Logic, Timing, Utilities = 36 items) and searched the palette for 'polar', 'align' and 'pole' with zero hits; confirmed at source: packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/providers/sequence/node_palette.dart has no PolarAlignmentNode entry, while the class exists (alignment_and_dome.dart:319) and has a full properties editor (_motion_rich.dart:966), summary, timing, validation and serialization. It is only reachable via Smart Night plan generation (smart_night_service/sequence_emitter.dart:242) or by importing a .json sequence.

seq-node:PluginInstructionNode.why: Only surfaces in the palette when a plugin registers a node blueprint (node_palette.dart:510-571 builds 'Plugins / <category>' sections from pluginNodeBlueprintsProvider, whose default is an empty list). No plugins were installed in the scratch profile, so the palette had no Plugins section and the node could not be added.

widget:guide_health_card.dart.why: Instantiated only by apps/mobile (screens/dashboard/tabs/devices_tab.dart:101). Zero instantiations anywhere in the desktop app — the desktop Guiding screen renders its own Guide Graph/RMS readouts instead. Not reachable from the surface under audit.

widget:catalog_setup_dialog.dart.why: Startup-only surface with exactly one call site (screens/shell/app_shell.dart:310) and it never fires on this machine. The gate needs BOTH star and DSO catalogs to be missing, but CatalogManager stores them in the SHARED application-support directory, not in SKOTIQ_DATA_DIR: /home/scdouglas/.local/share/com.skotiq.desktop/catalogs/ already holds hyg_v42.csv, NGC.csv, glade_plus_galaxies.csv, dso_metadata.json, deep_stars/ etc. So starStatus.isInstalled && dsoStatus.isInstalled are true for every sandbox profile and the dialog is suppressed. Wiping the developer's real catalog directory is the only way to reach it, which is not acceptable in a sweep. Verified the other two gates were satisfied: an equipment profile exists (so shouldRunEquipmentOnboarding is false) and app_settings has no 'catalog_setup_skipped' row.

widget:connection_stale_banner.dart.why: Refuted by live drive on a paired client: connectionStaleProvider is written ONLY by apps/mobile/lib/main_parts/mobile_connection_state.dart:278,288 — the desktop remote client never sets it even though the widget is mounted in the desktop shell (app_shell.dart:460) and NetworkBackend.reconnectNow() exists. Killed the appliance mid-session and watched through the reconnect window: red icon only, no banner. Dead code on desktop unless the desktop connection-state machine is wired to it.

widget:database_recovery_launcher.dart.why: Mounted at the app root (app.dart:198) but only surfaces when the database open fails and a recovery/backup path exists. Every launch in this sweep opened /tmp/ns-audit/r-shared-widgets/data/skotiq.db cleanly. Forcing it means deliberately corrupting the scratch DB header mid-sweep, which would have destroyed the seeded session/frame/narrator fixtures the rest of this area's units depend on.

widget:details_panel.dart.why: A `part of` catalog_overlay_widget.dart, whose only non-test instantiation is screens/imaging/widgets/live_preview_area.dart:445. That overlay only builds once the live preview holds a plate-SOLVED frame (a WCS is required to place catalog objects). The audited rig is the simulated camera with no solver: the Imaging screen showed the persistent banner 'Annotations are enabled but no catalog is installed' and the Analytics solve card read '0 of 14 solved'. No solve, no overlay, no details panel.

widget:actions.dart.why: `part of` widgets/focus_model_curve_card.dart. FocusModelCurveCard has zero instantiations in the desktop app: repo-wide the only non-test caller is apps/mobile/lib/screens/dashboard/tabs/devices_tab.dart (imported as `show GuideHealthCard, FocusModelCurveCard`). Same situation as guide_health_card.dart - mobile-only, not reachable from the desktop surface under audit.

widget:filter_offsets.dart.why: Same file family as actions.dart - `part of` focus_model_curve_card.dart, which is instantiated only by apps/mobile devices_tab.dart. Not reachable from the desktop app.

The card is gated on the first-launch coach being finished (and suppresses itself whenever the Smart Night prompt is eligible); onboarding was skipped on this scratch profile so the coach never completed, and I had no supported way to mark it complete from the UI. Its sibling Smart Night prompt was driven and is reported below.

screen:settings/observing_lists_settings.note: Driven live: reachable via Settings search (both its label "observing" and its keyword "wishlist" find it) and via the Science group, where it is a merged section (settings_catalog.dart:518, merged at :806). Honest empty state with a next action; New List / Create Your First List both open the dialog; Create with an empty name is refused with "Enter a list name" and writes nothing (observing_lists count stayed 0). screen:settings/filter_settings_row.dart.why: A sub-row of the Autofocus filter table, rendered only when a filter wheel is connected with named filters. Not reached in this pass: the fresh profile lands on the Equipment first-run wizard and connecting a simulated wheel first was cut short. The settings-imaging sweep DID observe this table populated with 7 filters (L,R,G,B,Ha,OIII,SII) and filed a finding from it, so the widget is known to render; what is untested is operating its per-filter controls.

mobile:first_run_setup_screen.dart.why: FirstRunSetupScreen is only mounted by mobile_dashboard_screen.dart:96 when shouldRunFirstRunSetupProvider resolves to setupNeeds.hasAnyMissing, which requires a live NetworkBackend session against a paired host whose /api/info reports a missing image output path, missing catalogs or no equipment profile. With no appliance paired the gate never renders it. I did reach the shell via 'Skip Connection (View UI Only)', but that path lands in the SHARED 13-step wizard (packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/onboarding/onboarding_screen.dart), not this file - confirmed by the on-screen title 'Set up your rig / Step 1 of 13', which exists only in onboarding_screen.dart:736, whereas first_run_setup_screen.dart has three steps (output path, catalogs, profiles). The one appliance reachable from this emulator is another agent's live desktop instance on the host at 10.0.2.2:8391, and pairing with it would both violate the no-appliance premise of this sweep and disturb a concurrent audit.

mobile:checkpoint_resume_dialog.dart.why: Shown only from _checkForCheckpoint (mobile_reconnect_ops.dart:552-583), which runs once after a connection is established and returns early unless executor.getCheckpointInfo() yields a checkpoint with canResume == true - i.e. it needs a host with a sequence run that was interrupted mid-flight. Unreachable with no appliance and no prior run. Source read only: the dialog itself is a pure presentation widget over CheckpointInfo with Discard/Resume actions and no network calls, and its caller already loops until resume-or-discard succeeds rather than stranding the checkpoint.

mobile:session_replay_screen.dart.why: SessionReplayScreen requires a runId and is pushed from exactly one place, session_picker_screen.dart:244 `builder: (_) => SessionReplayScreen(runId: run.id)`, inside the tap handler of a run row. Run rows come from NetworkBackend.fetchSequenceRuns, so the list is only ever non-empty when the phone is paired with a host that has completed sequence runs in its database. Driven disconnected, the picker correctly renders its 'Connect to a server' empty state instead of any rows, so there is no row to tap and no runId to pass. Pairing with the one appliance reachable from this emulator (another agent's live desktop on the host) would both break the no-appliance premise of this sweep and disturb a concurrent audit. Source-only observations: the screen accepts a dataSourceOverride for tests (session_replay_screen.dart:35-41), and its own disconnected behaviour is therefore untested here.
